Chapter 523: Chapter 17 The Galaxy Master Arrives (Please Subscribe)

“`

“The Tianyu Clan has launched a war?”

Lin Yuan’s gaze reached distantly toward the direction of the B0001 Exotic Battlefield.

At this moment, his Taiji Primordial Spirit was about to arrive at the center of the battlefield, faintly perceiving the fluctuations of combat between Eighth Layer invincibles.

“As long as I can block or repel the Tianyu Clan, I can at least gain ten million merit points,” Lin Yuan thought to himself.

Even for an invincible of the Eighth Layer who spends countless years battling on the Battlefields of Different Races, amassing such a large number of merit points is very difficult.

...

For an evolutionary scholar like Lin Yuan, relying on the breakthrough of the Ninth Stage Martial Tao Chapter was the only way to gain an equivalent number of merit points.

As for the other methods? The efficiency is too low, with time required exceeding several hundred thousand to millions of years.

And—

Merit points are just Lin Yuan’s guaranteed minimum gain.

During the confrontation with the many strong warriors of the Tianyu Clan, as long as he can kill the Eighth Layer invincibles of the opposing side, all the spoils of war naturally belong to Lin Yuan.

Not long ago in the Milky Way Star Region, the two Eighth Layer invincible beings of Different Species whom Lin Yuan killed had given him spoils of war worth nearly five hundred thousand Cubic Universe Crystals.

Indeed, those two Eighth Layer invincibles of Different Species hadn’t expected to die, so they carried many treasures with them, resulting in Lin Yuan’s exceptionally high gains.

But the number of Eighth Layer invincibles from the Tianyu Clan on the battlefield is far more than just two, and if the quality isn’t enough, quantity will make up for it.

In any case, Lin Yuan was very much looking forward to his upcoming gains.

…

At the center of Battlefield B0001.

The Baiyun Lord and a Six-Winged Elder of the Tianyu Clan stood facing each other, standing tall in the void, two utterly different cosmic forces, like the sea, surged tumultuously and collided relentlessly.

“Baiyun, you’re still the same old you, your moves haven’t changed at all, fighting with you is actually quite boring,” the Six-Winged Elder sneered.

“Is that so?” The expression of the Baiyun Lord remained unchanged. In terms of command over cosmic force, he was inferior to the Six-Winged Elder.

The latter’s cosmic force was high-level cosmic force, but the Baiyun Lord’s cosmic force was special, capable of holding off the Six-Winged Elder.

“Slash.” The Six-Winged Elder lifted his right hand and pressed it down toward the Baiyun Lord.

Suddenly, the ferocious cosmic force converged, like an extremely sharp divine weapon, slashing down towards the Baiyun Lord.

The cosmic force wielded by the Six-Winged Elder originated from the spatial storms produced by the shattering of the void, an endless space transforming into blades, obliterating everything.

“You haven’t changed much either, still the same few moves,” the Baiyun Lord snorted coldly, and within a hundred million miles around him, suddenly, clusters of white clouds appeared.

The clouds intertwined and merged, colliding with and annihilating the cosmic force the Six-Winged Elder had slashed down.

In just a few breaths, a large portion of the two kinds of cosmic force vanished, the rest rapidly dissipating into the void.

“Baiyun has blocked it.”

“At least he wasn’t injured.”

The dozens of human Eighth Layer invincible evolvers below let out a slight sigh of relief.

The Baiyun Lord was the most powerful of the Eighth Layer invincibles on their side, and even though the Galaxy Master was paying attention, they couldn’t be completely useless and just wait for the Galaxy Master to intervene and save them.

“Ha ha ha ha ha, since that’s the case, let me show you my new technique,” the Six-Winged Elder chuckled lightly, “This move has only recently been comprehended from the depths of my clan’s bloodline, enjoy it.”

After speaking, the Six-Winged Elder gently spread the six pairs of wings on his back, the pristine wings as if strumming the strings of a harp, causing the space in all directions to undulate like flowing water.

“Hm?” The Baiyun Lord furrowed his brows, the undulating space began to assault the cosmic force around his body.

The cosmic force that resembled white clouds slowly crumbled under this invisible spatial undulation, swiftly spreading toward his true body.

“What kind of technique is this?” The Baiyun Lord’s face showed a slight change; he immediately gathered his cosmic force, focusing it within a few miles of his body, barely managing to block the encroaching spatial undulation.

“This is troublesome.” A heavy feeling settled in the heart of the Baiyun Lord.

Under the spatial undulation stirred up by the Six-Winged Elder, he was forcibly confined within a few miles.

Although he was confident in blocking the Six-Winged Elder’s subsequent attacks, he clearly had no ability to intervene in the outside world.

This meant—

The Six-Winged Elder had already limited him, allowing himself the spare energy to deal with the human Eighth Layer invincible evolvers.

“Up to now, you haven’t used any secret treasures; it seems that this time your trump card isn’t an external object but calling for reinforcements, right?” The Six-Winged Elder looked down at the Baiyun Lord and spoke indifferently.

“Bring out whatever reinforcements you have quickly, or it’ll be too late.”

The Six-Winged Elder raised his left hand and pressed down towards the other human Eighth Layer invincible evolvers.

Buzz.

Strands of spatial undulation spread like running water, quickly expanding to millions of miles. At this moment, space was like an iron box—on the human side, the evolvers, even the invincible of the Eighth Layer, found their flying speeds drastically reduced.

“Go ahead and attack.”

As soon as the words of the Six-Winged Elder fell, dozens of Eighth Layer invincible beings from the Tianyu Clan started to approach them.

Various cosmic forces erupted wildly, forming profound currents and spreading toward the side of the human evolvers.

“This isn’t good.”

The Baiyun Lord, who was bound by the Six-Winged Elder, changed his expression dramatically.

The Six-Winged Elder has the excess strength to strike, suppressing the speed of all human Eighth Layer invincible evolvers in the battlefield, forcing them to face the Tianyu Clan’s Eighth Layer invincibles head-on.

This was not a good sign.

Let’s not talk about the number of Eighth Layer invincible warriors of the Tianyu Clan being higher than the human Eighth Layer invincible evolvers.

The Six-Winged Elder was still by the side watching, able to strike at any time.

“Galaxy Master, Galaxy Master, please take action quickly.”

At this moment, the Baiyun Lord could only place all his hopes on Lin Yuan.
